- Iceland EU referendum on a knife edge as counting continues: A vote on whether to resume membership talks with the European Union is too close to call.
- WhatsApp chat used to send cash for crime and extremism: The WhatsApp money launderers arranged cash transfers in the UK and around the world with no paper trail.
- At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot: An investigation has begun into the storage of weapons for Ukraine's military near a residential area.
- Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos deported from US to UK: The self-styled provocateur had been detained by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).
- Canada installs large Lake Ontario sign in latest jab at US: Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiled a billboard on Canada's shoreline with the message: "Lake Ontario. Now and Always."
- Norway's new king remembers 'my dear father' in first speech: Haakon VIII pays emotional tribute to his late father, Harald V, before outlining how he wishes to reign.
- Former Ecuadorian president imprisoned for corruption: Lenín Moreno denies taking bribes from a Chinese firm to secure a contract to build a hydroelectric plant.
- Ex-White House teleprompter operator ordered to pay $172,000 for Trump speech bets: The staffer was found to have used his prior knowledge of the president's speeches to place lucrative bets.
- Dutch health institute issues 'red alert' over Trump-shaped ecstasy pills: The drugs have a delayed effect which "increases the risk of overdose", the health institute says.
- Australia usually hosts the world's biggest cuttlefish mating event - not this year: According to official figures only 1,811 cuttlefish turned up to mate this year, down 97% on last year.
- Norway's King Harald dies aged 89: A beloved monarch buffeted by family crises: The late king, who reigned for 35 years, broke with tradition by marrying a commoner and was widely loved by Norwegians.
- King Haakon begins reign after turbulent year for Norwegian monarchy: Haakon becomes the king at a turbulent time for Norway's monarchy.
